chunks: But never did a prophet come at whom they did not scoff.
ai.seo_question: Why did the Israelites constantly mock the prophets sent to them?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Az-Zukhruf underscores the persistent spiritual blindness of the Children of Israel, who mocked prophets from Moses to Jesus, a pattern that foreshadows their rejection of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and the Imams. It highlights the theological concept of *istihza'* (mockery) as a symptom of deeper arrogance (*istikbar*) and serves as a warning that divine truth is often dismissed by those entrenched in worldly pride.
